reconciliation.scope: Release arc: v0.17.0 (advisory release_base; derived authoritatively by the evaluator on read via gitLatestTag, excluding --release-version) through evaluated_commit (intended release v0.18.0). The v0.17.0..evaluated_commit arc is the v0.18.0 MINOR feature arc and carries real consumer-facing behavioral changes (this is NOT a docs-only arc): the P1-GATE-002 trio — a4afe6e (Slice A) makes the durable closeout ledger record post-commit HEAD, 6f524bd (Slice B) adds the no_head_progress / could_not_land status vocabulary, and 5495a9e (Slice C) adds the doctor head-progress HEAD-staleness WARN check #19; b852408 encodes the operator-interaction contract across release-flow surfaces; 6a99269 lands the v0.17.0+b852408 follow-up batch (callable-graph, erratum, contract guard). No breaking change: all edits are additive (new ledger field, new status vocab, new doctor check, new contract surfaces). Go green was verified at evaluated_commit by the build agent: go test ./... (all ok), go vet ./... (clean), go build ./... (clean), and gofmt -l . (empty); the embedded corpus was refreshed via make (the binary rebuilds before any update, satisfying the stale-embed guard; ./bin/vh-agent-harness doctor = HEALTHY, embedded corpus matches templates/core). Reconciliation: promoter-mode scan of .local/coordinator/tasks/ against the v0.17.0..HEAD diff (22 changed paths) found SIX fired-trigger candidates plus one retained unsupported card. defer-012 (no_head_progress status logic test) did NOT fire — its trigger uses the unsupported always_before(...) grammar which the promoter reports as unknown-predicate/not-met. The six fired: defer-013 (could_not_land post-head assertion gap; Slice B crux test outcome assertion — yes+disclose+valid, fail-closed-safe), defer-014 (closeout-ledger flock-absent non-Linux coverage; Slice A defense-in-depth branch — yes+disclose+valid), defer-readme-defer-liveness-check-doc (trigger re-fires on README.agent.md traffic but gap already resolved in 8d9e44d5 pre-v0.17.0 — no+disclose+valid), defer-release-override-sha-doc-drift (trigger re-fires on releaser.md traffic but gap already resolved in 38c5c477 pre-v0.17.0 — no+disclose+valid), defer-release-readiness-attestation-separation (releaser self-attestation authority-model gap; non-blocking, deterministic gates hold and this release uses a separate reporter — yes+disclose+valid), and normalizer-archive-companion-tension (pre-existing backlog-split design tension re-surfaced by commit-gate.sh touch; two-commit workaround — yes+disclose+valid). The retained unsupported defer-p1-lineage-002-001 keeps its no+disclose+invalid disposition (legacy ||-chain grammar, trigger not met, neither renderstate/ nor seam.go touched this arc). All seven records disclose; zero refusals; zero blocking ids.

records.summary: P1-GATE-002 B crux test verifies could_not_land JSON+ledger status but does not assert the ledger record's post_commit_head == unchanged branch HEAD (outcome assertion gap; behavior is correct).

The record IS written with current_head by the Slice B code; only the equality assertion (post_commit_head == unchanged branch HEAD) is not exercised by the test. Fail-closed-safe and non-blocking: the could_not_land status is correctly emitted and the ledger record is correctly written; the gap is a missing outcome assertion, not a behavioral defect. Disclosed for operator visibility before tagging. Card metadata is well-formed (single clean path_touched predicate), so metadata_state=valid.
